data.title: Eric Trump-Led American Bitcoin To Adopt Michael Saylor’s Approach of Selling BTC to Support Economics? CEO Says…
data.description: American Bitcoin Corp. (NASDAQ:ABTC) CEO Mike Ho sidestepped questions on Monday about selling Bitcoin (CRYPTO: BTC) to fund equity buybacks, a move some other companies in the industry have pursued. American Bitcoin’s ‘North Star’ During American Bitcoin’s second-quarter earnings call, Ho was questioned about the company’s treasury management strategy and whether it would contemplate selling Bitcoin to improve business economics, similar to the approach taken by Michael Saylor’s Strategy Inc.
